answer: A grant pool pays agents to estimate pigment concentrations for a glacier atlas. Limit subsidized claims to five per verified operator each month. A zero-knowledge proof shows an unrevoked operator credential and derives a public monthly nullifier; all agent keys delegated by that operator debit the same five-claim counter. Aliases therefore cannot reset the allowance. Farming 500 claims requires recruiting 100 separately verified operators and paying their cooperation costs. Enrollment must deduplicate people; credential rental and corrupt issuers remain risks.
